data: sql "SELECT CAST(floor((x - 657000) / 100) * 100 + 50 AS DOUBLE) AS gx, CAST(floor((y - 6867000) / 100) * 100 + 50 AS DOUBLE) AS gy, CAST(CASE WHEN classification BETWEEN 2 AND 6 THEN classification ELSE 7 END AS INT) AS cat, CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS n FROM input GROUP BY 1, 2, 3"

sql "SELECT gx, gy, cat, n, sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY gx, gy ORDER BY cat ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - n AS start, sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY gx, gy) AS total FROM input ORDER BY gx, gy, cat"
